name: Echo STT
summary: A diagnostic STT provider that plays your microphone back instead of transcribing.
description: Registers as a speech-to-text provider, plays each audio chunk the daemon streams to it out of the default audio device as it arrives, and returns a transcript describing the audio rather than its content — byte count, sample count, sample rate. It exists to answer one question with your ears: is the daemon sending a plugin the audio you think it is, at the volume you spoke, without gaps. Wear headphones; it plays your microphone through your speakers. Needs an audio output device (ALSA on Linux); with none it keeps running silently.
